image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of four ring binders standing upright in a row on a shelf. From left to right: a grey binder with a green spine/top, a light green binder, a blue binder, and a large red binder. The binders have rigid covers and visible spine labels. The red binder is the most prominent foreground object.
